correctness.rationale: The actual graph edge set comprises a 2n-cycle plus n antipodal chords, each spin has degree 3. For negative-spin S, the exact energy is 3nJ-2nh+2(h-3J)|S|+4J e(S). Twisted rung representation shows maximum independent set n for odd n, n-1 for even n; for even n, all n-sets have >=1 internal edge, with exactly 2n sets attaining one, whereas 2n independent size-(n-1) sets have an empty rung. Comparing these two affine energy branches locates h=J; at h=3J every independent set is a ground state and tr(P T^n) gives I_n=(1+sqrt2)^n+(1-sqrt2)^n-(-1)^n. Independent enumeration for n=3..8 at h=0,1/2,1,2,3,4 checked energies, counts and endpoints. Spin reversal gives negative-field cases. Finite experiments corroborate analytic graph reasoning.
